title: Everything Below the Stairs
subtitle: 危险防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 危险防范（灾害防范·危险与逃生）
meta: 主题语境：危险防范（灾害防范·危险与逃生）　|　核心词汇：property　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 property 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The flood took eleven houses and no lives, which the council said twice on the radio and which nobody in our street found comforting. What it took from my grandmother was everything below the stairs: the ① property of forty-one years, in a house she had bought in 1963 for eleven hundred pounds. She had never thought of herself as a woman of ② property, and she said so in the road, in her coat, with the water still in the hall.

The forms, when they came, were four pages long and divided the loss into two kinds. There was ③ property damage, which they could pay for, and there was ④ personal property, which they mostly could not, and the difference between the two turned out to be the whole argument of the next eleven months. My mother, who filled the forms in, said it is a ⑤ property of the word that it can mean a house and a kettle at the same time.

She was right. The ⑥ property insurance paid for the stairs, the floor and the doors, and paid nothing for the photographs, which were in a box under the stairs and which nobody has seen since. My grandmother said the ⑦ most valuable property in the house had been the box. The council said the box was not ⑧ property at all, by which they meant it was not part of a house.

What I remember of that year is how often the word property came up in a street where nobody had ever used it before, and how quickly everybody learned it: the ⑨ property of a thing, it turned out, is not the thing itself but the right to say what happens to it.

There is a ⑩ property of water, my grandmother said once, which is that it takes the lightest thing first and leaves the heaviest behind, and I have thought about that for twenty years. It is the same property the forms had.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 财产；所有物；资产
B. n. 房产；不动产；地产
C. n. 特性；性质；属性
E. 固定搭配：property damage 财产损失
F. 固定搭配：personal property 个人财物；动产
G. 固定搭配：property insurance 财产保险
H. 固定搭配：a woman / man of property 有产者；有产业的人

items.q: it is a property of the word
The property insurance paid for the stairs
the most valuable property in the house
the council said the box was not property at all
the property of a thing, it turned out, is not the thing itself
There is a property of water

answers.why: property 意为“财产、所有物”，指楼下的四十一年的家当。
a woman of property 意为“有产者、有产业的人”，祖母从不把自己看成这种人。
property damage 意为“财产损失”，是表格里保险公司肯赔的那一部分。
personal property 意为“个人财物、动产”，是表格里多半不肯赔的那一部分。
a property of ... 意为“……的特性”，母亲说这个词的特性是能同时指房子和水壶。
property insurance 意为“财产保险”，它赔了楼梯、地板和门。
the most valuable property 意为“最值钱的财产／东西”，祖母说最值钱的是那只盒子。
property 意为“房产、不动产”，议会说盒子根本不是不动产，因为它不是房子的一部分。
the property of a thing 意为“一件东西的所有权／产权”，即决定它如何处置的权利。
a property of water 意为“水的一种特性”，水先带走最轻的东西。

她说屋里最值钱的东西是那只盒子。（property）
一件东西的产权不是东西本身，而是决定它如何处置的权利。（the property of）
answers: What the flood took from my grandmother was everything below the stairs: the property of forty-one years.
She had never thought of herself as a woman of property.
The forms divided the loss into property damage and personal property.
The property insurance paid for the stairs, the floor and the doors.
She said the most valuable property in the house had been the box.
The property of a thing is not the thing itself but the right to say what happens to it.
